title: What Are These, Trading Cards?
description:
Alright, I've strung you along for long enuff. Let's get to learning 'bout grading. Now, what is it, you ask? Well, graded materials offer stronger stats than non-graded materials. A regular old iron pickaxe will be okay, but an iron pickaxe made with grade A iron? Now that's gonna be stronger and last longer. Is not jus' the materials that matter, quality can make a huge difference.
Now, to make a Material Grader, [you're gonna need some Blaze Gold, Iron, Quartz, and an Advanced Upgrade Base](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/material_grader.png:124:62). In addition to the grader, you'll need a catalyst. Basic stuff is [Glowing Dust](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/glowing_dust.png:124:62), but if you're feeling adventurous, crush up sum blaze gold with a hammer on the stone anvil, then craft it together with sum glowstone dust fer sum [Blazing Dust](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/glowing_dust.png:124:62).
Once ya got the catalyst, just pop it into the grader with your material of choice and let it do its thing. After a bit o' waiting, you'll get the graded result, going from E to MAX. Best part? You can always pop the graded material in again to regrade it. You'll never get a grade worse than what it already is, but it can take sum time and catalysts to get sumthin higher, provided it can go any higher to begin with.
